title: A/R Collection: the PDF and CSV carry the phone and credit term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on, so the credit term shows.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with two overdue invoices, a phone number and a credit term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only customer A ticked.
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the PDF and read customer A's line.
  3. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 2:

  • The same phone and credit term as on screen, on the customer's line.

Step 3:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 4:

  • In the heading row "Phone" and "Credit term" columns come right after "Customer".
  • Both of customer A's rows carry customer A's phone and credit term.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R3: “The PDF prints the same phone and credit term on each customer's line; the CSV carries them in columns (S3-R8a).”
  • S3-R8a: “On A/R Collection, every CSV row also carries the customer's "Phone" and, for users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Credit term", in columns right after "Customer"; the PDF prints them on each customer's line (Story 9).”
